blurb: Ballet Hop! offers a variety of dance classes including ballet, contemporary, and barre workouts for all ages and levels. They provide flexible class cards and memberships, private lessons, kids camps, and a ballet retreat. Special events include birthday parties and studio rentals.
extraNote: Class cards are non-refundable but do not expire · Subscriptions are non-refundable but can be paused or stopped upon request · 12 hours cancellation notice required to avoid losing class spot · 50% deposit for ballet retreat is non-refundable and non-exchangeable · Remaining 50% of retreat price can be credited if cancelled 30 days before start · $150 security deposit for birthday parties refundable if no damage · Birthday party deposit non-refundable if cancelled 7 days or less before event
